title: Create Refined Sand Papers

body:
# Create Refined Sandpapers **Three tiers of upgraded sandpaper for [Create](https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create) — more durable, faster polishing.** ![Minecraft 1.21.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-brightgreen) ![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-NeoForge-orange) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-red)
--- ## Tiers | Tier | Durability | Polish Speed | Enchantable | |---------------|-------------|--------------------------|----------------------------| | **Andesite** | 32 uses | Slightly faster | Yes (Unbreaking, Mending) | | **Diamond** | 64 uses | Faster | Yes (Unbreaking, Mending) | | **Netherite** | Unbreakable | Fastest + fire resistant | No | ## Features - All tiers work in **Deployers** for full automation - Full **JEI** integration — browse polishing and deploying recipes from each sandpaper - Andesite and Diamond tiers support **Unbreaking** and **Mending** - Netherite is completely unenchantable (unbreakable — no point) ## Requirements - Minecraft 1.21.1 - NeoForge 21.1+ - Create 6.0+ ## Author Made by [2binary]()
